prompt.project_info: Create ultra-realistic professional fashion photography on a luxury modern villa terrace with detailed natural textures.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with long platinum blonde loose waves, light tan skin, a slim curvy athletic build, extensive floral and ornamental tattoos across arms, legs, and torso, and a confident relaxed slightly serious expression. She wears a green geometric patterned bikini and small narrow sunglasses.
prompt.composition_elements: She reclines sideways on a circular outdoor lounge chair, leaning on one arm with legs extended. Use a full-body eye-level frame with a round wicker daybed, beige cushion and pillows, green patterned fabric draped on the chair, minimalist concrete walls, glass railing, lush tropical plants, and clear blue sky.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright harsh midday natural sunlight with sharp realistic shadows, warm natural color grading, luxury relaxed confident summer-lifestyle mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 85mm lens, moderate depth of field with sharp subject and softened background, ultra-realistic high-resolution fashion editorial, detailed skin, tattoo, fabric, wicker, and architectural texture, natural saturation and medium-high contrast.
